latest_release.name: MediaPipe v1.2.3
latest_release.body:
### Bazel changes

- Migrate `mediapipe::NoDestructor` to `absl::NoDestructor` (`absl/base/no_destructor.h`) in `mediapipe/framework` and remove obsolete `mediapipe/framework/deps/no_destructor.h`.
- Respect TensorBufferRequirements alignment in InferenceRunnerLiteRt
- Resolve file-path media parts in SemanticRetriever::Retrieve before embedding.
- [MediaPipe] Fix tensor view destruction deadlock on LiteRT run error.
- Register only the CPU accelerator in LiteRT environments for CPU-only runners.
- Add NPU dispatch library directory to C MpBaseOptions.
- Forward BaseOptions app telemetry in C++ tasks and Swift wrappers.
- Unify util/endian.h using absl/numeric/bits.h and remove deps/endian.h
- Format C++ code and fix includes in framework
- Format C++ code and fix includes in gpu
- Bump MediaPipe version to 1.2.3
- Support string input tensors in the MediaPipe LiteRT inference runner.
- Update Swift Package Manager files for the 1.2.3 iOS release.
- Added  C API classifier options conversion to MPPClassifierOptions+Helpers

### MediaPipe Tasks update
This section should highlight the changes that are done specifically for any platform and don't propagate to
other platforms.

#### Android
- Unify MediaPipe Tasks option, method, and result names across Python, Web, Android, and iOS while preserving deprecated compatibility aliases, and update DevSite guides and code snippets.

#### iOS
- Add pure Swift microphone audio recording for MediaPipe Tasks iOS.
- Add pure Swift vision running mode, image processing options, and segmentation mask for MediaPipe Tasks iOS.
- Add pure Swift vision image input container for MediaPipe Tasks iOS.
- Add C API image conversion and ScopedMpImage to MPPImage+Utils.
- Add C API task runner helpers and VisionCallbackPool to MPPVisionTaskRunner.
- Remove legacy iOS C++ task runners, packet creators, and protobuf helpers.
- Migrate TextClassifier to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate TextEmbedder to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate LanguageDetector to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate TextSummarizer to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate TextProofreader to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate AudioClassifier to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate UniversalEmbedder to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate ImageClassifier to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate ImageEmbedder to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate FaceDetector to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate ObjectDetector to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate FaceLandmarker to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate HandLandmarker to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate PoseLandmarker to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate HolisticLandmarker to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate GestureRecognizer to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate ImageSegmenter to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate InteractiveSegmenter to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Migrate InteractiveSegmenterLegacy to MediaPipe Tasks C API.
- Unify MediaPipe Tasks option, method, and result names across Python, Web, Android, and iOS while preserving deprecated compatibility aliases, and update DevSite guides and code snippets.

#### Javascript
- Remove on-disk cache options from the web audio LiteRT-LM tasks.
- Fix DecisionMaker Web SDK APIs, boolean scoring, and native in-memory CPU loading.
- Support incremental TextToSpeech stream input on the web.

#### Python
- Expose BooleanQuestion and ChoiceQuestion examples in the Decision Maker C API and Python.


### MediaPipe Dependencies
- Explicitly include direct headers and BUILD dependencies.
- Update MediaPipe Tasks Web WASM files.
